message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 73.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and Business process analyst. I want to become a Database Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 800 per year. I live in Chennai. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This MSc Cloud Computing program is the strongest technical match for your goal of becoming a Database Administrator and aligns with interests like parallel computing. It requires a CS background, which suits your app development certification and IT/CS degree. Crucially, it meets all your constraints: the tuition ($550) is well under your $800 budget, and the program is located in Chennai. The main trade-off here is that its placement rate (59%) is slightly lower than the alternative option.

While this MDes Interaction Design program meets all your strict constraints—including being in Chennai and having a low tuition cost ($450)—it presents a significant subject matter trade-off. This field is design-focused (design_hci) rather than technical or data-centric, making it less aligned with your goal of becoming a Database Administrator. However, if job placement is the absolute priority, this program offers a higher placement rate (66%) and salary ($8418) compared to PR0165.
